title: Wedges fine, room silent
intro: The band can hear themselves. Look at what feeds the main speakers.

complaints.says: Nobody out here can hear anything, but the band sounds fine on stage.

hints: If every wedge works but the room is silent, the problem is after the channels: the Main bus or the main speakers.
cause: The Main bus was muted on the mixer, so nothing reached the main speakers. The monitor mixes don't go through Main.
lesson: Everything-silent-in-one-place points at what that place shares: here, the Main master. Check its mute and fader first.
